_comment: Curated roster of key OT contributors/influencers — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for person-centric ingestion. Signal follows people, not surfaces: a key person's insight is high-value whether it lands in a diff, a Workplace post, or a watched-space message. Consumed by ot-ingest-diffs (surfaces contains 'diffs') and ot-ingest-posts (surfaces contains 'posts'). Operator-curated (operator 2026-06-13: 'pull from key people ... whoever are the key contributors and influencers ... different people have different trust level').
_trust_scale: Operator JUDGMENT. 3 = authoritative (treat as ground-truth-grade OT signal; headline it). 2 = high-value domain expert (weight it, verify cross-source). 1 = useful signal (log, don't headline). Trust flows into ingested output so downstream consumers (change-delta-first triage, distillation) can weight by it. Current roster: all 3 (operator 2026-06-13).
_surfaces: diffs = Phabricator authored diffs (via ot-ingest-diffs). posts = Workplace posts (via ot-ingest-posts). gchat-mentions = the person's messages in WATCHED TEAM spaces only (reserved; not yet wired).
_privacy: Only TEAM-VISIBLE authored artifacts. NEVER DMs, inbox, calendar, or anything individual-scoped (CLAUDE.md 'no individual-scoped data'). gchat-mentions, when wired, means messages in watched team spaces — never a person's private chat.
_candidate_discovery: ot-ingest-diffs additionally resolves the mrs_online_training oncall rotation live; any active member NOT in this roster is surfaced as a propose-only candidate (never auto-ingested), so new platform devs get noticed while curation stays operator-controlled.
